grammar.topic: Adverbs and intensifiers (very, really, quite, extremely)
explainTr: Güçlendirici zarflar (intensifiers) sıfatın gücünü ayarlar: a little / slightly (az), quite (oldukça), very / really (çok), extremely (son derece). Hepsi sıfatın önüne gelir: very polite, extremely tired.
Fiilin önünde 'really' kullanılır: I really like it. 'Very' fiille kullanılmaz: 'I very like it' hatalıdır. Olumsuzda 'not very' pek değil demektir: The test wasn't very hard.
'Quite' sıfat + isim önünde 'a' ile kullanılır: quite a nice class. 'Very' ve 'extremely' için 'a' sıfattan sonra gelir: a very nice class.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'çok' her yerde kullanılır: çok güzel, çok seviyorum. İngilizcede 'çok' yerine sıfatın başına very/really/extremely, fiilin başına really koyarsın. 'I very like' demeyiz; 'I really like' veya 'I like it very much' deriz.

examples.en: She is quite a good teacher.

exercises.q: Ms. Park is ___ a kind teacher.
exercises.whyTr: 'A + sıfat + isim' önünde 'quite' kullanılır: quite a kind teacher. 'Very a kind' denmez.

exercises.q: The students were ___ noisy. I couldn't hear anything.
exercises.whyTr: Çok güçlü anlam için extremely kullanılır.

exercises.q: She speaks English ___ well for a beginner.
exercises.whyTr: Zarfı güçlendirmek için very kullanılır: very well. 'Very much well' denmez.
Really fiilden önce gelir: really like.

exercises.q: "The class was quite quiet." means the class was ___.

exercises.answer: The students were extremely polite today
She is really good at helping children

exercises.q: The room is ___ noisy to think. Let's go to the library.
exercises.whyTr: Too + sıfat: fazla gürültülü (4. gün konusu).

exercises.q: "Don't talk," said the sub. → The sub told them ___ talk.
"Are you ready?" → She asked if they ___ ready.
The students were ___ polite today. I was impressed.
exercises.whyTr: Güçlendirici zarf: very / really / extremely / quite.

exercises.q: The test wasn't ___ difficult. Everyone finished early.

reading.title: Hafsa's behavior report
reading.text:
On Friday, Hafsa finished her first full week as a substitute teacher. In the afternoon, she sat at the desk in Ms. Park's room and began to write a behavior report. Ms. Park always wanted to know how her students behaved.

"The class was really good today," Hafsa wrote. "Most of the students were extremely polite. They said 'please' and 'thank you' every time. Noah, who is usually shy, was quite helpful. He passed out the books before lunch without being asked."

Then she wrote about the harder moments. "Two boys in the back were very talkative. They were quite disruptive during the reading time, so I moved them to different seats. After that, they were fine. One girl, Maya, looked a little distracted and did not finish her worksheet. I think she was really tired."

Hafsa stopped and thought. She wanted the report to be honest, but she also wanted to be kind. She wrote, "Overall, the students were very cooperative, and I enjoyed the day."

When she finished, Mr. Brown walked in. "How was your day, Hafsa?"

"Excellent," she said, smiling. "The children were extremely energetic, but they were also very respectful. I learned a lot this week."

"That is great," Mr. Brown said. "You are doing really well."

Hafsa felt proud. She put the report on the desk and went home.

questions.whyTr: Metin: 'began to write a behavior report'.

questions.q: Why did Maya probably not finish her worksheet?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'looked a little distracted... I think she was really tired'.

writing.promptTr: Bir sınıfın davranışı hakkında öğretmene kısa bir rapor yaz. very, really, quite, extremely gibi güçlendiricileri kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a short behavior report for the teacher. Use very, really, quite and extremely.
writing.model: Dear Ms. Park, the class was really good today. Most of the students were extremely polite and very helpful. Noah passed out the books without being asked, and I was impressed. Two boys were quite talkative during reading time, so I moved them to different seats. One girl, Maya, looked a little distracted, and I think she was really tired. The math lesson was not very difficult, and the students finished it early. Overall, the class was very cooperative, and I enjoyed the day. Thank you, Hafsa
checklistTr: En az üç farklı güçlendirici (very, really, quite, extremely) kullandın mı?
Hem olumlu hem sorunlu davranışı yazdın mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
